steps: Use a browser whose colour scheme is dark (the default the harness opens with)
Open a section page, click Print a test
Emulate print media / save as PDF (page.pdf)
expected: The printed test is black text on a white page regardless of the on-screen theme; the test container is styled bg-white and the print stylesheet sets body to white.
actual: In print media under the dark scheme the test panel keeps its dark background (computed rgb(27,36,41)) while body is white; the PDF is a dark grey block with pale text on every page (5 pages), and in emulated print media the headings/questions compute to black-on-dark. Switching the scheme to light fixes it, so it is the dark-theme override of the container background leaking into print. Browsers that force a light scheme when printing will not show this; those that honour the scheme print a dark, ink-heavy page.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=11.3&count=20&seed=42 (or any test containing a multi-part or table answer: 1.2 seed 147372, 1.3 seed 42, 1.4 seed 3, 2.1 seed 42, chapter 2 seed 5, Practice Test 1)
Look at the answer key page
expected: Multi-part answers are rendered as a plain a./b./c. list and table answers as a real table, like the questions are.
actual: The key prints literal markup: '[PARTS]' and '[/PARTS]' lines around multi-part answers (question 7 and 9 of section 1.2 seed 147372; 1, 10, 15 of 1.3; 5, 6 of 1.4; question 1 of Practice Test 1), '[TABLE]'/'[/TABLE]' with pipe-separated rows for table answers (11.3 Q8, 1.3 Q10, 2.1 Q9), and in 11.3 Q12 a nested '[PARTS] i. ... [/PARTS]' followed by a second '[/PARTS]'. On screen and in the PDF the learner sees the raw tags.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=1.2&count=0&seed=1 (shows 'Too small: expected number to be >=1')
Edit the address bar to #/print?scope=section&id=1.2&count=10&seed=1 and press Enter (hash change, no full reload)
actual: The previous error message stays on screen and no questions render (0 items) until the page is fully reloaded. The same happens for every bad->good hash navigation between print URLs (a count=500 error persisted onto three later valid URLs). Navigating away through the site nav and printing again does work.

steps: Look at question 7 (Literary Digest, parts a-d) and question 9 (parts a-d) in print media
expected: Each lettered part gets its own writing space, or at least the box is sized for four answers.
actual: All four parts are listed and then a single ~80px dashed box follows the last part; parts a-c have no space next to them, so a learner must cram four written answers into one small box.

steps: From section 1.2 click Print a test
Click 'New test (different questions)' one or more times
expected: Back returns to the previous test (each test has its own URL, so a learner expects to be able to step back to the one they just printed).
actual: 'New test' replaces the history entry; a single Back jumps straight to the section page and every earlier test is gone from history. The only way back to an accidentally replaced test is to retype its test code from a printout.

steps: Open the home page, chapter 1 and chapter 13 pages
Look for a way to print an OpenStax final exam
expected: The About page lists 'final exams' among the included OpenStax material and the print route supports scope=final (#/print?scope=final&id=1&count=10&seed=1 renders 'OpenStax Final Exam 1'), so some page should offer it.
actual: No page links to a final exam; chapter pages only offer the chapter test and (for chapters 1, 13 etc.) 'Print OpenStax Practice Test N'. The final exam is reachable only by hand-typing the URL, and the URL takes a count so a learner cannot tell how many questions the whole exam has.

expected: Questions start with a readable stem.
actual: Chapter 3 Q7 begins with a bare URL (http://www.esa.doc.gov/...pdf) and contains '&mathematics)' before the actual question. Chapter 2 Q1 has no stem: it starts directly at 'a. For runners in a race...'. Several table questions start lowercase ('the table below contains...'). Noted only; content is audited separately.

Q8 key total reads '10,0450' (typo for 100,450); Q10 key runs 'the year.df = 12' together; Q2, Q3, Q7 show the answer twice (the explanation line just repeats the answer). Noted only; content is audited separately.
